verdict: A classic attempt at business casual that fails as hard as his students on the calculus midterm.
detailedQuote: The structured dark blazer screams grant proposal presentation, while the light-wash denim indicates complete surrender to grading fatigue. It is a calculated compromise between administrative decorum and endless whiteboard derivations.
